risks.summary: Repository protection settings are not yet independently observable.
Infrastructure preflight is blocked by API, budget, quota, inventory, and IaC gaps.
Brand font licensing is unresolved; dashboard uses system fallbacks.
Live OAuth, provider routing, infrastructure, and production readiness are deliberately absent and must remain fail-closed.

deployments.reason: Slice 0 explicitly excludes GCP, Cloudflare, DNS and deployment mutations; the verified terminal is a local build and browser test only.

deployments.rollback: Stop only the named local processes, run docker compose down --volumes after exact target verification, and remove only ignored generated outputs; no external state exists to roll back.

costs.reason: No deployed MatchBASE workload and no budget visibility.
Every fixture capability attempt records explicit zero synthetic cost; live/deployed cost remains UNKNOWN and release-blocking.
